name: quadcastrgb
description: Set RGB lights on HyperX QuadCast S and Duocast microphones

repo.name: QuadcastRGB
repo.description: Set RGB lights on HyperX QuadCast S and Duocast

readme.summary: Well-structured documentation with comprehensive installation instructions across multiple platforms and solid troubleshooting coverage, but lacks detailed configuration reference for all available modes and options.
readme.top_issue: No documentation of command-line flags/options (e.g., -u, -l, -b, -a) beyond what can be inferred from examples — a dedicated options reference section is missing.

injection_risks.description: Use of atoi() function without checking for errors, potentially leading to unexpected behavior
Use of strtol() function without checking for errors, potentially leading to unexpected behavior

critical_findings: Potential for unexpected behavior due to lack of error checking in atoi() and strtol() functions
Lack of input validation for negative numbers and non-numeric input
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential injection risks and lack of input validation, but no critical secrets or error exposure issues were found.

common_complaints: No support for new QuadCast 2/2S hardware variants (3+ requests)
Missing or incomplete macOS support initially
Build failures on different platforms (AUR, Homebrew)
Lack of documentation and user guidance
praise_themes: Appreciation for tool existence (filling gap where official software doesn't support Unix)
Thanks for enabling RGB control on unsupported platforms
Community willingness to provide detailed technical info and test help
sentiment.summary: Community is engaged and grateful for the project, but frustrated by limited hardware variant support; maintainer shows moderate activity with periodic issue closures but many hardware requests remain unaddressed.

communication.summary: The maintainer provides useful information and is patient, though there could be more clarity in some responses.
